stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
If $U$ and $V$ are cosimplicial objects in the category $\mathcal{C}$,
and if $U \times V$ exists, then we have
$$
\Mor(W, U \times V) =
\Mor(W, U) \times
\Mor(W, V)
$$
for any third cosimplicial object $W$ of $\mathcal{C}$.
